title: Is IPTV Legal? Licensed Services & FAST Channels Explained
description: Clear answers on IPTV legality in the UK and US, how to recognise licensed services, and guides to free ad-supported (FAST) channels you can watch legally.
intro: IPTV as a technology is perfectly legal; what matters is whether the service holds the rights to the channels it carries. This section explains the law in plain terms for UK and US viewers, how to tell a licensed service from an unlicensed one, and which legitimate free options exist.

faq.question: Is IPTV illegal in the UK?
faq.answer: No. IPTV is a delivery method used by licensed broadcasters and streaming services. Watching unlicensed streams can however break copyright law. See our full explainer for the details.
